messages:
rachel_owens: Heads-up — Prospect MercuryPay wants a POC but legal flagged the KMS/HSM items. They want to know if we can support an offline key ceremony, what attestation artifacts are required, and whether theres any additional charge for the handshake.

ben_singh: Short answers: yes we support offline ceremonies for Private/Dedicated; required artifacts = vendor-signed attestation (FIPS 140-2/140-3 or vendor-equivalent), HSM cert chain, and a key lifecycle diagram. Theres a one-time onboarding/ceremony fee + monthly connector if they proxy the HSM during POC.

mohit_gupta: Add ops detail: to do proxied BYO-HSM we need an allowlist from their network team (CIDR + ports) and an SSO list for ceremony observers. We can run a staged POC: 1) Redwood-managed keys for dev tests (fast), 2) proxied BYO-HSM with attestation for security validation, 3) offline ceremony for Prod.

rachel_owens: Can you paste exact allowlist lines for their infra ticket?

ben_singh: Paste below — they can copy/paste into firewall ticket:

ben_singh: ```
# Primary proxy endpoints (TLS)
34.199.76.12/32:443
34.199.76.13/32:443
# Outbound ports required:
- TCP 443 (TLS)
- TCP 5001-5003 (ephemeral health checks, optional)
Note: allow SNI for our proxy cert and permit TLS ALPN negotiation.
```

mohit_gupta: Security note: attestation must include the HSM model + FIPS validation certificate number and a statement that CMKs are non-exportable (if customer requires non-exportability). Also request their rotation policy (sample: KEK rotate every 90 days, CMK rotate every 12 months).

rachel_owens: Procurement asks whether the onboarding fee is refundable if POC fails.

ben_singh: Onboarding fee covers ops time + dry-run. Standard practice is non-refundable but we can credit it toward a Dedicated contract if they convert within 90 days. I'll have finance confirm the exact wording.

legal-bot: Reminder: include a copy of the signed AUP for ceremony observers and confirm the smallest set of SSO ids (emails) needed for access.

mohit_gupta: Timeline: if they provide allowlist + attestation by Wed EOD we can do networking test Thu, proxied handshake Fri, dry-run ceremony next Tue. Expect 2-3 business days of ops coordination for the ceremony itself.

rachel_owens: I'll send them the staged plan + allowlist snippet + pricing note (non-refundable onboarding fee, credit on conversion). Will ping when they upload artifacts. Thanks! :thumbsup:
